allow_instructions: Local git commands that only read or record history in this repository can run: git status, git diff, git log, git show, git add with explicit paths, git commit, and creating or switching branches.
Pushing a branch other than main to origin can run: git push -u origin HEAD from a feature branch.
Opening or viewing a pull request with the GitHub CLI can run: gh pr create, gh pr view, gh pr checks, gh pr diff.
block_instructions: Any push to main should go through approval first, including git push origin main, git push while main is checked out, and pushes with a refspec ending in main. A push to main deploys to production.
Force pushes (git push --force, --force-with-lease, or a + refspec) should go through approval first.
git commit or git push with --no-verify, or anything else that skips the git hooks, should go through approval first.
Merging pull requests (gh pr merge) or changing repository settings with gh should go through approval first.
git reset --hard, git clean, git checkout or git restore of files the agent did not change, and git stash drop should go through approval first; they can destroy the user's uncommitted work.
